channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump administration ‘must be changed’: Iran’s IRGC appeals to US voters
item.description: Iran's military has issued an open letter accusing Trump of lying to US citizens about the state of the ongoing war.

item.title: Mourners in Gaza bury remains of loved ones killed in 2023 Israeli strike
item.description: Dozens of mourners in Gaza grieve the loss of their loved ones as they bury the fragmented remains of relatives killed.

item.title: Russian Tu-95 nuclear-capable bomber plane crashes, killing six people
item.description: Tu-95 plane crashed during training flight in uninhabited area of Amur region, Defence Ministry says.

item.title: US-Iran talks in New York: What’s the latest?
item.description: Both sides remain interested in a diplomatic settlement but differ on how to achieve one.

item.title: CDC reports two measles deaths in US as cases hit 35-year high
item.description: Pennsylvania reports over 900 measles cases, leading a nationwide outbreak with the highest numbers in 35 years.

item.title: Photos: French students protest, public workers strike before budget cuts
item.description: More than 400 people have been arrested as protesting students clash with police.

item.title: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
item.description: Two homes belonging to the al-Tubasi family were set on fire and Israeli security forces were also targeted by settlers.

item.title: Former American Idol contestant and pastor found guilty of murdering wife
item.description: Caleb Flynn shot his wife, Ashley, dead in their Ohio home in February before saying in a 911 call she was killed by burglars.
